name: Lateral Movement Indicators
description: Remote execution and access on the target: logons with explicit credentials, remotely installed services and scheduled tasks, admin-share access, RDP authentication and WinRM sessions. Narrower than before: every logon, every Sysmon process and network event, and Kerberos tickets are left to their own profiles.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)
